description:
GISGP Lite ($6 a month, $3 for 7 days, or $1 once for 24 hours) — pass the api_key of that
    account (or Authorization: Bearer). convert one GIS
    file between formats with the full site converter: input shapefile (.zip), KML/KMZ, GPX, CSV,
    GeoJSON, GPKG, FlatGeobuf, MapInfo TAB (.zip, source="mapinfo-tab"), FileGDB (.zip,
    source="filegdb"), DXF or DWG; `to` geojson | shapefile | kml | kmz | gpx | csv | xlsx | gpkg |
    flatgeobuf | mapinfo-tab | wkt | dxf. `source_epsg` for projected CSV / a shapefile without .prj,
    `target_epsg` to reproject (GeoJSON-composable pairs). File up to 4.5 MB inline (base64). Returns
    JSON {ok, filename, content_type, size, data_base64} or {ok, download_url} for big results,
    {ok: false, error, pairs} otherwise.
name: convert_file
